content.short: Lagoon is an EVM infrastructure to launch, manage and scale on-chain vaults.
content.description: Lagoon provides a vault infrastructure designed to distribute on-chain yield efficiently. Built on Safe and leveraging ERC-7540 and Zodiac modules, Lagoon offers a modular, standards-based framework that lets each curator tailor the vault environment to their exact needs. This ranges from bespoke onboarding flows to precise governance controls, including full control over stakeholder spending permissions. In practice, Lagoon empowers diverse projects to deploy and manage on-chain yield with clarity and security.

resources.title: Lagoon's Fee Structure: The Four Fee Types, Explained
resources.tldr: Management, performance, entry/exit and protocol fees, with the actual formulas, caps and accrual mechanics rather than a summary. Rare to see a vault show this much of its arithmetic.

resources.title: Agentic Finance: How AI Agents Work With Lagoon Vaults
resources.tldr: Moving agents from chat to actual capital means letting them discover a vault, read its state, and act on it. Describes what each of those three steps requires.

resources.title: More Than Vaults: Lagoon's Open Data Layer
resources.tldr: An SDK reading contracts directly, plus a public GraphQL API with no key required. Worth reading for the argument that vault data should be queryable by anyone, not just the operator.
